arStrings.szText: Something has gone amiss at the Pools of Creation. We must act swiftly if we are to create the world our lord desires.
Hint of urgency. Mephisto's plans are going sideways, and his servants are trying to find a way to bring about the Age of Hatred another way.
Gather the pilgrims who follow Akarat. Bring them to the Garden.
